text:
Type: oval galvanized plant tub with handles
Use: holding several plants or herbs, or as a storage tub; kitchen, living room, balcony
Style: farmhouse, industrial, rustic
Materials: galvanized steel, wire handles with wooden grips
Colors: silver grey metal, warm brown wood
Shape: wide oval tub tapering toward the base, rolled rim, embossed rectangular label plate on the side, two swing handles at the ends, sturdy and roomy
Feel: rustic, practical, casual, nostalgic
Goes with: green herbs, reclaimed wood, white brick, black metal; farmhouse, industrial or rustic kitchens and living rooms

product.name: GRSLK
product.description: The handles make it easier to move the plant pots.
